title: Persona Feature Control of Emergent Misalignment: Testing OpenAI's Mechanism on Open Models

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Validates or challenges OpenAI's mechanistic claim about persona features mediating misalignment. If activation steering controls misalignment at inference time, it is a direct mitigation tool. Connects emergent misalignment to mechanistic interpretability at a fundamental level.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires fine-tuning to induce misalignment, then performing activation extraction, PCA/probing analysis, and activation steering experiments. TransformerLens adds a learning curve. Multiple sophisticated techniques chained together. Challenging for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Multiple complex steps: fine-tune, extract activations, identify persona features, implement activation steering, evaluate. Each step requires debugging. Very ambitious for 30 hours even for experienced practitioners.
